authority: This public history is a reviewed web projection of the Lab's canonical Timeline Register and selected provenance material. The Lab repository remains the source of record. Inclusion on this page records historical significance; it does not by itself establish scientific validity, causal priority, product readiness, or outside recognition.

automation.note: Timeline admission remains human-reviewed. The website may refresh from canonical Lab state, but it does not automatically create or admit historical milestones.

timeline.authorityCeiling: The Timeline Register preserves reviewed institutional history and durable event identity. Being included means an event matters to the Lab's history; it does not prove causation, scientific correctness, product success, or future fulfillment.

events.title: Early physics experiment: why a soccer ball curves
events.summary: An early research project turned curiosity about a curving soccer ball into a concrete Magnus-effect experiment.
events.unresolved: Primary project artifacts remain recovery targets in the source timeline.

events.title: Software design becomes process-first
events.summary: Documented software-design work began treating workflow and system representation as things to design explicitly, not just implementation details.

events.title: Agile becomes an explicit delivery method
events.summary: Software consulting and delivery experience developed into a more deliberate method for sequencing work, feedback, inspection, and completion.

events.title: Independent research grows into a room-scale workbench
events.summary: By roughly 2019–2021, independent research had a dedicated physical environment of notes, books, whiteboards, diagrams, and active research surfaces.
events.unresolved: Approximate chronology remains source-owned and may be refined by later provenance recovery.

events.title: Boundary First Labs becomes an explicit institution
events.summary: In 2026, accumulated research, software, experiments, methods, and product work were organized under Boundary First Labs as a public institution.
events.unresolved: Additional 2026 milestones remain to be recovered and adjudicated into durable Event identities.

provenanceGallery.publicClaim: A substantial room-scale independent research environment existed before the current AI-accelerated Lab.
provenanceGallery.claimCeiling: The preserved media establishes the scale and organization of that research environment. It does not establish the correctness, originality, or maturity of every mathematical or scientific claim visible in it.

artifacts.title: Research-room survey
artifacts.alt: Derived still from the research-room survey video showing the physical working environment.
artifacts.description: A five-still sequence derived from the preserved research-room survey video, showing the physical environment as a moving spatial record rather than a single page or wall crop.
artifacts.establishes: Direct moving-image evidence of a substantial pre-AI room-scale research environment and its spatial organization.
artifacts.publicUse: Yes, narrowly. The sequence establishes environment, scale, and organization; it does not establish exact dates or correctness of the mathematical work.

sequence.note: Five derived stills preserved from the original research-room survey video and presented together as a stitched pan sequence. Exact extraction timestamps are not asserted in this web projection.
